protocol.selection: minimum validation mean cross-entropy; earliest epoch on exact tie
protocol.test_use: baseline and primary seed after frozen checkpoint; public benchmark, pilot previously viewed
protocol.shuffle: fresh library permutation recorded each epoch

limitations: Two prespecified configurations, not exhaustive tuning comparison
50-epoch budget; no claim of numerical convergence
Three seeds only; spread is descriptive, not confidence interval
Public test benchmark had earlier pilot results; not freshly sealed
No product IDs in source to verify group independence
28x28 grayscale benchmark does not represent arbitrary shop photographs
